notes: Mizoram: mizoram.gov.in itself is a client-rendered SPA with no crawlable department list, so the 41 departments were built from the portfolio breakdown already recorded in each minister's `holder.notes` in states-mz-nl-tr.json (high confidence — those notes are themselves sourced). officialUrl was only kept where the department's own *.mizoram.gov.in subdomain resolved and its <title> confirmed the name (checked 2026-09-25); omitted elsewhere rather than guessing. Secretaries: only Home and Finance were confirmed (via each department's own 'List of Officers' page); no consolidated cross-department secretary/posting list could be found within the research budget (no site-wide directory, WebSearch budget exhausted for this run), so all other Mizoram department secretaries are omitted per the schema's 'omit rather than guess' rule. Nagaland: department list and secretaries are sourced from the official State Portal's AHoDs (Administrative Heads of Departments) page (https://nagaland.gov.in/ahods, accessed 2026-09-25, 36 entries with name/designation/department charge) — this is the strongest single source found across all three states. Only 15 of the resulting ~39 departments could be matched to a minister via the existing minister portfolio notes in states-mz-nl-tr.json; the remaining departments' headPositionId defaults to the Chief Minister at confidence:'low' with a note flagging that the minister-in-charge needs confirmation against a current (2025-2026) allocation-of-business notification — Nagaland's coalition cabinet and frequent portfolio reshuffles make this genuinely uncertain rather than a gap in research effort. Tripura: department list is from the official 'Departments & Organizations' index at https://tripura.gov.in/departments (accessed 2026-09-25); secretaries are all from the official 'Senior Officers in Administration' page (https://tripura.gov.in/senior-officers-administration, page-updated-date shown on the page as 22-09-2026, accessed 2026-09-25) — a single authoritative, dated, cross-department posting list, the best source found in this run. Tripura splits several departments (e.g. General Administration, Finance, PWD) into sub-charges each with its own named 'Department' on the departments index; these are modelled as separate state_department entities per the official listing. Where the senior-officers list shows one secretary jointly charging multiple named departments, that is noted under each department's secretary Position. Several sub-departments (Elementary Education, Horticulture & Soil Conservation, Taxes & Excise) could not be matched to either an existing minister note or the senior-officers list and are flagged confidence:'low' with the Chief Minister as a residual default rather than guessing a specific minister.
